protocol.title: Synchronized Synthesis of Peptide-Based Macrocycles by Digital Microfluidics
protocol.platform: Two-plate digital microfluidics (DMF) on EWOD/electrode array
protocol.objective: Synchronized parallel on-chip synthesis of five peptide-based macrocycles (PMs) from amino acids, aziridine aldehyde, and tert-butyl isocyanide; subsequent aziridine ring-opening with thiobenzoic acid to yield macrocyclic peptide thioesters (ROPs); and demonstration of a nine-membered macrocycle from a Pro-Leu dipeptide substrate

device.device_surface: Teflon-based hydrophobic insulator (chemically inert; compatible with organic solvents and corrosive chemicals)
device.actuation_principle: Electrical potentials applied to electrode array coated with hydrophobic insulator; discrete droplets actuated in parallel (EWOD)
device.top_plate: Transparent ITO glass (removed for product isolation)
device.notes: First two-plate DMF platform for multi-component, multi-step parallel chemical synthesis. No pumps, tubing, valves, or external hardware required.

PhCOSH.role: nucleophilic ring-opening of aziridine in PM products

TFE.role: re-dissolution solvent for dried PM spots; 4 x 900 nL droplets per spot (~3.5 uL total)
TFE.compatible_with: wide range of organic solvents and reagents on Teflon surface

dipeptide_substrate_9mer.notes: Modelled as AminoAcid_Pro in BioScript manifest; see compiler notes

chemistry.chemoselectivity: high; products contain aziridine sites for late-stage nucleophilic modification

ring_sizes.nine_membered: 9-membered macrocycle (from Pro-Leu dipeptide; conventionally difficult to access)

ring_opening.significance: Thioesters are precursors to native chemical ligation (S-to-N acyl transfer)

steps.name: PM synthesis — amino acid + aziridine aldehyde merge
steps.purpose: Imine formation between amino acid and aziridine aldehyde

steps.name: PM synthesis — tBuNC addition and macrocyclization

kinetics.note: Future rapid-mixing integration anticipated to improve DMF kinetics

steps.name: PM isolation by TFE evaporation
steps.method: Top plate removed; TFE allowed to evaporate; solid PM precipitates on electrode
steps.notes: No volume limit on re-dissolution solvent; flexible vs microchannel platforms

steps.name: PM synthesis QC — MS and NMR verification

verification.agreement: Near-identical spectra between DMF and macroscale products (Supporting Information Fig S5a,b)

steps.name: ROP — PM re-dissolution in TFE
inputs: TFE (4 x 900 nL = ~3.5 uL per dried PM spot)
steps.operation: dispense + serial mix (4 TFE aliquots chained to accumulate ~3.5 uL)
steps.purpose: Re-dissolve dried solid PM for subsequent ring-opening reaction
steps.bioscript_op: tfe1-4 dispensed; chained mix to pmSolnX
steps.notes: Four droplets driven to dried spot by electrode actuation. Highlights DMF flexibility: no volume limit on re-dissolution unlike microchannels (Fig 3, frames 1-2).

steps.name: ROP — PhCOSH merge and ring-opening incubation
steps.bioscript_op: mix pmSolnX with phcoshX for 20s; heat ropMixX at 25c for 60m

steps.name: ROP isolation by TFE evaporation
steps.product: macrocyclic peptide thioester (ROP) precipitated at defined electrode position

steps.name: ROP QC — MS and NMR verification

verification.NMR_reference: Supporting Information Fig S6 (PM-Met), Fig S7 (ROP-Met)

steps.name: Nine-membered macrocycle synthesis
steps.substrate: Pro-Leu dipeptide (0.1 M in TFE, 900 nL, 90 nmol)
steps.mixing_schedule: every 30 min (6 x 20 s circular electrode actuation over 3 h)
steps.bioscript_note: Periodic mixing encoded as single heat 180m; self-mix rejected by BioScript symbol visitor

verification.significance: Conventionally very difficult to access by macroscale cyclic peptide synthesis; prior attempts yielded only cyclodimer in poor yield (Failli et al. 1979)

parallel_synthesis_summary.bioscript_note: BioScript has no parallelism primitive; 5 tracks encoded sequentially but represent concurrent physical on-chip operations

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Phase 1 PM synthesis (5 tracks) + macrocycleQC detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(macrocycleSignal); Phase 2 ROP synthesis (5 tracks) + ringOpeningQC detect

cfg.dag_structure: Two nested diamond gates; 7 nodes, 8 edges; verified against jebrail_macrocycle_dmf_main_dag.dot

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 7 basic blocks (BB1-BB7), 2 if/else gates, 8 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: All durations converted to seconds (s) or minutes (m) as BioScript supports only s and m tokens (h not supported)

known_constraints.no_parallelism_primitive: Five PM tracks and five ROP tracks encoded sequentially; concurrent on physical device
known_constraints.self_mix_rejected: BioScript symbol visitor rejects mix(var, var); periodic 9-mer mixing replaced with single heat 180m
known_constraints.case_sensitive_variables: aamet vs aaMet caused UndefinedVariable crash; fixed to aaMet
known_constraints.drain_normalised_to_dispose: BioScript IR emits dispose() opcode for both dispose and drain BioScript keywords; distinction only meaningful at physical execution layer
known_constraints.dipeptide_manifest: Pro-Leu dipeptide modelled as AminoAcid_Pro; separate manifest ProLeu_Dipeptide recommended in full implementation
